title: One Chrome extension for every agent
app: SpecWithCode built from PR #400 (store install) merged with PR #411 (Copilot tools over http), disposable server on 127.0.0.1:8351; SpecWithCode Browser 1.0.1 from the Chrome Web Store
offCamera: copilot.sh: tools/bin/copilot runs the installed GitHub Copilot CLI with the real HOME (its sign-in is in the login keychain)
seed.sh: greet-app with a one-page demo on 127.0.0.1:5173, specweave init . --quick, committed; the Copilot provider in studio/userdata/settings.json
codex-auth.sh: short-lived Codex login in the demo HOME (no refresh token, mode 600)
record.mjs --prepare: welcome wizard, ~/greet-app as a Local folder, Full access
comment: One continuous headless take of two browsers: the app (take.webm) and a Chrome profile with the store build of SpecWithCode Browser (chrome/page-N.webm, one per page). Headless Chrome has no toolbar, so the popup opens as a tab and is zoomed 2.2x. The pairing code is blurred in both places. Beat ids match vo-lines.json and edit.json.

steps.text: Open the link in the Chrome profile agents should use. Chrome keeps the extension up to date.
In my Chrome, open http://127.0.0.1:5173, type Ada in the name field, press Greet, and tell me what the page shows.
In my Chrome, open http://127.0.0.1:5173 in a new tab, type Grace, press Greet, and tell me what it shows.
